name: Tronxy (Shenzhen Tronxy Technology Co., Ltd.)
summary: Shenzhen 3D-printer maker that also sells own-label filament, mostly PETG (rapid, metallic and transparent) plus TPU and glow PLA, through Amazon and tronxy3d.com at budget prices. The filament extruder is not identified.

product_lines.name: Standard PETG (transparent colours)
product_lines.notes: Brand store lists bed 80-90 C, 30-60 mm/s, +/-0.05 mm.

additional_notes: Primarily a printer maker. Filament is probably OEM-sourced, but there is no evidence of the source, so no relationship is recorded. Example product page: https://tronxy3d.com/products/petg-3d-printer-filament-1-75mm-diameter-tolerance-0-05-mm-1-kg-2-2lbs-spool-1-75-mm-petg-filament-for-3d-printer-transparent-red

provenance.conflicts: Legal entity name comes from a search summary, not a registry. Filament sourcing and manufacturing country unknown.
